hero.title: Teachings of Buddha
hero.description: A comprehensive study of the core philosophical tenets of Buddhism, focusing on the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Tenets

  • Four Noble Truths
  • Eightfold Path (Ashtangika Marga)
  • Doctrine of Dependent Origination (Pratityasamutpada)

Philosophical Concepts

  • Anicca (Impermanence)
  • Anatta (No-Self)
  • Dukkha (Suffering)
  • Four Noble Truths (Aryasatyani):
    • Dukkha: The world is full of suffering.
    • Dukkha Samudaya: Desire (Tanha) is the cause.
    • Dukkha Nirodha: Suffering can be stopped by removing desire.
    • Dukkha Nirodha Gamini Pratipada: The path to cessation is the Eightfold Path.

items.decryption: Sila (Right Speech, Action, Livelihood), Prajna (Right View, Resolve), Samadhi (Right Effort, Mindfulness, Concentration).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing 'Anatta' (No-Soul) with the Upanishadic 'Atman' (Soul). Buddhism denies a permanent soul.
Assuming Buddha advocated for social equality; while he critiqued the Varna system, the order remained hierarchical.
